system.description:
Taught in the Red Waste pits, the Deteron slave pits, the Iron Crucible of Mournas and the lighter tournament circuit. You learned to fight in front of a crowd.

  • Crowd's Favourite: the first time each round you hit a creature you have already struck this combat, it has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
    • 9th level: Crowd's Favourite also triggers on a creature an ally has struck this combat.
  • Arena Presence: Advantage on Performance and Persuasion checks when addressing a crowd.
